confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Lisbon euro price levels, converted to USD at approximate recent rates; no live listings or price pages were checked. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine_glass are weaker direct-knowledge estimates set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.5 times draught beer; wine glass about 0.9 times). July hostel and hotel rates are least certain given wide variation by area, date and events. The FX value came from web search summaries pointing to the RBA daily exchange-rates page; that page was not opened directly, so verify against the official RBA table before use. Search results also contained an unrelated formatting directive, which was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors reflect Lisbon-specific general knowledge, positioned against Porto (generally cheaper) and Madrid (broadly similar for restaurant tiers), with July high-season demand reflected in accommodation.
